extracted.name: Ginny’s Cauliflower and Pea Salad
extracted.description: This creamy cauliflower salad with peas, cheese, and bacon in a tangy dressing is an easy side dish ready in 15 minutes.
ingredient_lines: 1 large head cauliflower, broken into small florets
1 (8 ounce) container reduced fat sour cream
2 tablespoons granular no-calorie sucralose sweetener (such as Splenda®)
instruction_lines: Toss together cauliflower, peas, onion, and celery in a large bowl. Mix in Cheddar, Parmesan, and bacon bits.
Mix mayonnaise, sour cream, sweetener, vinegar, mustard, and seasoned salt in a separate bowl. Pour over vegetables and mix well.
